linked_prs.title: feat: auto-approve compatible pending tools when allow always is selected
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

"Yes, allow always" works if LLM makes many tool calls in a single response.

## Dive Deeper

Currently, "Yes, allow always" only applies to new requests made by the LLM, not any existing requests that are buffered awaiting approval.

## Reviewer Test Plan

- Ask the CLI to `Create test1.txt, test2.txt, test3.txt in separate tool calls`. 
- Click always allow.
- Start a new session and ask it to `Create test4.txt, test5.txt, text6.txt and delete test1,2,3.txt in separate tool calls for a total of 6 calls`.

It will correctly approve all pending tool calls of the same tool once always allow is chosen for a tool. 

## Testing Matrix

|          | 🍏  | 🪟  | 🐧  |
| -------- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm run  | ❓  | ❓  | ✅  |
| npx      | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Docker   | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Podman   | ❓  | -   | -   |
| Seatbelt | ❓  | -   | -   |

## Linked issues / bugs

- Resolves #6122
